svg.title: The pieces and how they fit together
svg.text: 2 · The pieces, and how they fit together
Everything in this stage is built from one idea — a list of numbers — repeated at four sizes.
Its *direction* carries the meaning; its length is thrown away.
Two vectors are compared by the
number is the whole relevance gate.
WHERE VECTORS COME FROM — inside PubMedBERT
one layer — 12 heads, side by side
Every head sees all 768 numbers of the token. Heads differ in the weights they use, not in which
part of the token they are handed.
the token — all 768 of its numbers
the other eleven heads use the
The same token, after each layer. Every step is a small edit; together they move it a long way — it stops being
“muscle” in general and becomes “muscle” in this sentence.
↑ the vectors the model just produced
Steps 1–5 below walk this left to right. Everything after — the seed profile, the negative correction, the cut — happens in the third band,
and never touches the machinery in the second.
One sentence for the whole stage: turn every paper into one arrow, point an arrow at your topic, and keep the papers whose arrows
point most nearly the same way.
